metadata.question: The Landsat 8 satellite captures pictures of active fire in Monte Pisano, Italy on February 25, 2019, around 10:58 a.m. local time. Was the smoke plume moving in an eastern direction?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Landsat 8 Collection 2 Level-2 (LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2), date window 2019-02-25 08:30–11:30 UTC, AOI around Monte Pisano (10.28–10.60E, 43.67–43.85N). If no images, widen to full day; if still none, return C1.
2. Masking strategy: Use QA_PIXEL to mask clouds/shadows/snow/dilated/cirrus and QA_RADSAT to drop saturated. Scale SR and ST bands. Because question is about smoke, masking is necessary to avoid clouds.
3. Logic for valid vs null: Check collection size (C1), then valid pixel count after masking (C2). If smoke or hotspot cannot be derived (null stats), return C3. Otherwise, compute eastness by fraction of smoke pixels east of hotspot; decide Yes if majority (>=60%) and mean dLon > 0.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const aoi = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([10.28, 43.67, 10.60, 43.85], null, false);
    const targetUTC = ee.Date('2019-02-25T09:58:00Z');
    let start = ee.Date('2019-02-25T08:30:00Z');
    let end = ee.Date('2019-02-25T11:30:00Z');
    const scale = 1000;
    const maxPixels = 1e9;

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    function scaleL8(img) {
      const optical = img.select(['SR_B1','SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7'])
        .multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      const thermal = img.select(['ST_B10']).multiply(0.00341802).add(149.0);
      return img.addBands(optical, null, true).addBands(thermal, null, true);
    }
    function maskL8(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0);       // Cloud
      const dilated = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).neq(0);     // Dilated
      const cirrus = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).neq(0);      // Cirrus
      const shadow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).neq(0);      // Shadow
      const snow = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).neq(0);        // Snow
      const clearMask = cloud.or(dilated).or(cirrus).or(shadow).or(snow).not()
        .and(img.select('QA_RADSAT').eq(0));
      return img.updateMask(clearMask);
    }

    function getInfoAsync(obj) {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve, reject));
    }

    let col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
      .filterBounds(aoi)
      .filterDate(start, end);

    let size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
    if (size === 0) {
      // Widen to full day
      col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(aoi)
        .filterDate('2019-02-25', '2019-02-26');
      size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
      if (size === 0) {
        console.log('L8 Images: 0 (2019-02-25)');
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      }
    }

    // Pick image closest to target time
    const colSorted = col.map(img => img.set('tdiff', img.date().millis().subtract(targetUTC.millis()).abs()))
                         .sort('tdiff');
    let img = ee.Image(colSorted.first());
    const imgId = await getInfoAsync(img.id());
    const imgTime = await getInfoAsync(img.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm').cat('Z'));

    // Cloud stats before masking
    const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
    const cloud = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).neq(0)
      .or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).neq(0))
      .or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).neq(0))
      .or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).neq(0))
      .or(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 5).neq(0));
    const totalPx = await getInfoAsync(ee.Image(1).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('constant'));
    const cloudPx = await getInfoAsync(ee.Image(1).updateMask(cloud).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('constant'));
    const cloudPct = (cloudPx && totalPx) ? (100.0 * cloudPx / totalPx) : null;

    // Scale + mask
    img = scaleL8(maskL8(img));
    const validPx = await getInfoAsync(img.select('SR_B2').reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('SR_B2'));
    if (!validPx || validPx === 0) {
      console.log(`L8 Images: ${size}; Selected: ${imgId} @ ${imgTime}`);
      console.log(`Total px: ${totalPx}; Cloud px: ${cloudPx}; Cloud %: ${cloudPct !== null ? cloudPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}`);
      console.log('Valid px after mask: 0');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing: detect hotspot and smoke
    const blue = img.select('SR_B2');
    const green = img.select('SR_B3');
    const red = img.select('SR_B4');
    const nir = img.select('SR_B5');
    const swir1 = img.select('SR_B6');
    const swir2 = img.select('SR_B7');
    const bt = img.select('ST_B10');

    const ndvi = nir.subtract(red).divide(nir.add(red));
    const ndwi = green.subtract(swir1).divide(green.add(swir1));
    const blueRed = blue.divide(red);

    // Hotspot (active fire) proxy
    let hotMask = bt.gt(320).or(swir2.gt(0.25)).or(ndvi.lt(0.0).and(swir2.gt(0.2)));
    hotMask = hotMask.focal_max({radius: 60, units: 'meters'}); // expand a bit
    const hotPx = await getInfoAsync(ee.Image(1).updateMask(hotMask).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('constant'));

    // If no hotspot, try NBR very low
    if (!hotPx || hotPx === 0) {
      const nbr = nir.subtract(swir2).divide(nir.add(swir2));
      hotMask = nbr.lt(0.0).focal_max({radius: 60, units: 'meters'});
    }

    const hotPx2 = await getInfoAsync(ee.Image(1).updateMask(hotMask).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('constant'));

    // Smoke mask: bluish, low vegetation, not water, not bright SWIR (cloud)
    const smokeMask = blue.gt(0.06)
      .and(blueRed.gt(1.15))
      .and(ndvi.lt(0.35))
      .and(ndwi.lt(0.6))
      .and(swir1.lt(0.2))
      .focal_max({radius: 90, units: 'meters'}); // smooth/expand plume
    const smokePx = await getInfoAsync(ee.Image(1).updateMask(smokeMask).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
      geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('constant'));

    if (!hotPx2 || hotPx2 === 0 || !smokePx || smokePx === 0) {
      console.log(`L8 Images: ${size}; Selected: ${imgId} @ ${imgTime}`);
      console.log(`Total px: ${totalPx}; Cloud px: ${cloudPx}; Cloud %: ${cloudPct !== null ? cloudPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}`);
      console.log(`Valid px: ${validPx}; Hot px: ${hotPx2 || 0}; Smoke px: ${smokePx || 0}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation: plume eastness relative to hotspot centroid
    const ll = ee.Image.pixelLonLat();
    const fireLon = ee.Number(ee.Image(ll.select('longitude')).updateMask(hotMask).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('longitude'));
    const fireLat = ee.Number(ee.Image(ll.select('latitude')).updateMask(hotMask).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('latitude'));

    const dx = ll.select('longitude').subtract(fireLon);
    const eastIndicator = dx.gt(0).updateMask(smokeMask).rename('east').toUint8();
    const dxMean = ee.Number(dx.updateMask(smokeMask).reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('longitude'));
    const eastFrac = ee.Number(eastIndicator.reduceRegion({
      reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: aoi, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels
    }).get('east'));

    const dxMeanVal = await getInfoAsync(dxMean);
    const eastFracVal = await getInfoAsync(eastFrac);

    if (dxMeanVal === null || eastFracVal === null || isNaN(dxMeanVal) || isNaN(eastFracVal)) {
      console.log(`L8 Images: ${size}; Selected: ${imgId} @ ${imgTime}`);
      console.log(`Total px: ${totalPx}; Cloud px: ${cloudPx}; Cloud %: ${cloudPct !== null ? cloudPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}`);
      console.log(`Valid px: ${validPx}; Hot px: ${hotPx2}; Smoke px: ${smokePx}`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    console.log(`AOI: Monte Pisano IT; Target UTC: 2019-02-25 09:58`);
    console.log(`L8 Images: ${size}; Selected: ${imgId} @ ${imgTime}`);
    console.log(`Total px: ${totalPx}; Cloud px: ${cloudPx}; Cloud %: ${cloudPct !== null ? cloudPct.toFixed(1) : 'NA'}`);
    console.log(`Valid px: ${validPx}; Hot px: ${hotPx2}; Smoke px: ${smokePx}`);
    console.log(`Mean dLon (deg): ${dxMeanVal.toFixed(4)}; East fraction: ${eastFracVal.toFixed(2)}`);

    const isEast = (dxMeanVal > 0) && (eastFracVal >= 0.60);
    console.log(isEast ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
